transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Priya, thanks for taking the call. Tell me what drew you to the Senior Data Engineer role at WPP?

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: I've been working on similar Spark/Airflow stacks for five years and the chance to work across creative agencies is unusual; I want that breadth.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Walk me through how you'd debug a slowly-degrading dbt model run.

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: I'd start with dbt run --vars to isolate the failing model, then dbt-checkpoint diff against last green run, then check upstream source freshness, and last look at warehouse compute scaling.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Final two: how do you handle disagreement with a peer on a design choice, and what's your earliest start?

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: I write a one-pager surfacing the trade-offs and ask the senior engineer to weigh in. Earliest start mid-June.
